name: Garlic Dill Yogurt with Arugula & Fried Eggs

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches fresh dill
3 (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
Coarsely chop walnuts. Toast walnuts until fragrant (2-4 minutes). Stir in red pepper flakes and butter until melted. Set walnuts aside in a bowl and return skillet to the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup walnuts
1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Gently crack the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs. Cook in batches if necessary.
Trim off the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Shave the dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the medium bowl with the garlic.
Add plain yogurt, olive oil, salt and pepper to the medium bowl and stir until smooth and well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, toss arugula with remaining olive oil and salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide yogurt, flat bread, arugula, and eggs between plates. Top with walnuts and enjoy!
